theme: Resonance exact recall coverage + Cortex Tabs Observatory

outcomes.intended_user_result: Recall callers can trust coverage counts without receiving more data than their bounded budget allows.
outcomes.current_baseline: Bounded recall stops scanning at max_items, so coverage describes only the admitted prefix.
outcomes.acceptance: Exact authorized match counts and item-limit omissions pass focused and full release validation.

excluded_scope: No ranking change, model, embedding, provider, database migration, schema change, new Mind tool, source-family merge, compaction owner, or live-data rewrite.
